summary: preinstall hook chain-loads unpinned undeclared npm package
details: randompkga@1.0.7 ships only a package.json with a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `npm i randompkgb`. The package `randompkgb` is not declared in dependencies and is unpinned, so `npm install randompkga` fetches whatever version of `randompkgb` is currently published and executes its install-time code on the installer's machine. The package contains no other files or functionality — its sole on-install effect is to resolve and run a second-stage package whose contents the author can change at any time by publishing a new `randompkgb` version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
